purpose: Choose collaborator default model without retraining; internal post-manuscript comparison
cohort: Reuse existing fixed val=2000/test=1999 baseline-alive patients, identical source prefixes in both arms
observed: First up to 8 clinical target transitions in first 64 post-index source events, at or before death and five-year horizon; full observed prefix before each target, max 512
absent_outcomes: Report missing follow-up; do not fabricate negatives. Patient-average metrics across available transitions.
inference: Both arms use observed-history same/different-day event branches. FERMAT time head reads different-day branch; Task31 time head reads plain history as trained.
arithmetic: Same BF16 backbone, FP32 event log-softmax, FP64 log time probabilities; no top-k, temperature=1, no repeat penalty.
primary: Patient-mean joint negative log probability of observed event token and integer-day gap (lower better)
day_probability: Integer-day bin mass of each actual sampler: FERMAT p0 plus conditional clamp(Exp,1,29200); Task31 p0 plus conditional clamp(1+Exp,1,29200). No disease-analysis +1 shift in next-transition likelihood.

bundles.stop: First future DX/RX/PX day complete, death, horizon, or explicit unresolved cap
bundles.day_convention: floor(raw generated age - index_age + 1), exactly inherited next-record-day definition
bundles.ranking: Token presence frequency across 10 paths, all 17460 DX/RX/PX candidates, expected Recall@10 across ties
bundles.paired_randomness: Same per-patient/path uniform bank seeds, independent of labels; no reranking/tuning after results
bundles.cap_policy: Never exclude or call capped paths complete. If any path unresolved, patient recall is bounded [0,1]; overall paired difference bound combines resolved patient differences and worst-case unresolved bounds.

selection_rule: Promote Task31 only if VAL paired joint-NLL difference Task31-FERMAT has bootstrap 95% upper<0, VAL marginal-event-NLL mean difference<=0, and VAL generated-bundle Recall@10 worst-case cap-aware mean difference lower bound>=0. Otherwise retain FERMAT as default. These are selection guards, not formal equivalence/noninferiority tests.
uncertainty: 5000 paired patient bootstrap replicates, fixed fitted checkpoints and sampled paths, seed 20261021. Test results do not select model; report any validation/test disagreement.
stop: Exactly specified cohorts, 10 paths, 256 cap. No outcome-driven sample expansion, no additional training, no five-year generation. Numerical errors are logged; other patients continue; missing cases block a complete scientific claim until repaired.
existing_package: Preserve exports/FERMAT_SNUH_20261021.zip unless a separately versioned replacement is supported.
